name: Chris Pappas

issue_poll.name: Saint Anselm (Jun 2026) + UNH (Feb 2026)
issue_poll.note: Ranks 9-10 follow Saint Anselm June 2026 most-important-issue order after the first 8 (Social Security/Medicare 2%, n=38; Environment/Climate 2%, n=33); UNH full issue list not retrievable, so it could not break this tie.

issues.detail: DISCLOSE Act, overturn Citizens United, stock-trading ban, ethics office in law, judicial term limits
Cut zoning and permitting barriers, first-time buyer tax cuts; no amounts or named program
Add $1B to LIHEAP heating aid, suspend federal gas tax, exempt groceries from tariffs
Make no tax on tips and expanded Child Tax Credit permanent; no hikes under $400K; $1M+ earners pay more into Social Security
Move $75B of ICE money to local police; ICE body cameras and ID; fund 22,000 Border Patrol agents
Restore expired ACA premium credits; prescription-access bill
Oppose Iran war, aid Ukraine and Israel, sanctions on Russia; nothing checkable
Expand Pell and community college, debt relief for high-demand fields; no amounts or bills
No Social Security benefit cuts or privatization; top earners pay more payroll tax; raise low-income benefits; no cap level or bill
Keep existing IRA clean-energy tax credits against rollbacks; middle-class energy tax cuts; no targets or named bills

caveats: Plan scored from campaign releases and press coverage; delivery grading starts when the term begins and needs each issue's position confirmed as testable.
